svg.title: first_touch_thigh_running_quick · eight diagnostic frames
svg.desc: Eight evenly spaced sampled poses. Original skeleton diagram, not a character mesh. Cyan is left, purple is right, orange is ball, red is below floor. Root motion is recentered; numeric world position is retained.

g.text: Left: cyan · Right: purple · Ball: orange · Below floor: red · root recentered, common scale
Skeleton positions from measured animation. No mesh silhouette, collision hull or subjective visual-quality claim.
